title: Analyze CloudTrail Logs
description: Review the CloudTrail logs for related events to gather more context about the attempted stoplogging operation.
recommended_next_focus: Identify patterns or anomalies in the user's activity.

title: Investigate User Identity
description: Gather details about the user identity including the ARN and any associated credentials.
recommended_next_focus: Confirm the legitimacy of the user and investigate potential misuse.

title: Review IAM Policies
description: Examine the IAM policies associated with the user identity to understand the scope of access and any restrictions.
recommended_next_focus: Identify potential misconfigurations or unnecessary permissions.
